title: zazzle-csharp-indexer internal tools component diagram
description: The tools zazzled calls, grouped by where their answers come from: the index, git or the syntax tree of one C# file.

components.name: Internal tools
components.responsibility: Everything zazzled can call; tools/list shows none of it.

components.name: Index-backed tools
components.responsibility: overview, find_symbol and changed_since: answers from file records and stored symbols.

components.name: Git tools (GitTools.cs)
components.responsibility: git_log and git_blame with compact formats.

components.name: Terse view tool (ViewTool.cs)
components.responsibility: view: reads one .cs file in a root and returns its terse view under a header with the line count and the changes per step.

components.name: Gap report (ReportGapTool.cs)
components.responsibility: Puts the agent's one-sentence note into the usage log.

components.name: Shared helpers (ITool.cs, RootSet.cs)
components.responsibility: The tool contract, argument helpers and root:path references.

components.name: Content analysis
components.responsibility: The stored symbol format and the symbol name index.

components.name: Terse C# view
components.responsibility: Builds and formats the view from the file text.

components.name: zazzled
components.responsibility: Calls these tools by name over the daemon socket and offers them to agents as zazzle tools.

relationships.description: Files, Sync, ChangesSince, Gen and WaitReady.
find_symbol reads stored symbols through the name index; overview reads blob facts.
git log and git blame through Proc.Run.
Calls them with tools/call by name: view, overview, find_symbol, changed_since, git_log, git_blame, report_gap.
